overall_comment: High necrosis proportion drives a grade 4 assignment despite mild enhancement and T2‑FLAIR mismatch suggesting lower grade. Lack of perfusion, spectroscopy, and calcification data limits certainty of 1p/19q status. Confidence moderate for all predictions.
